- [USER] User inquired about the concept of a 360 degree view of the customer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A 360 degree view of the customer refers to a comprehensive understanding of a customer's behavior, preferences, needs, and interactions with a company across all touchpoints and channels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is a holistic approach to customer understanding that considers every aspect of the customer's journey, including purchase history, interactions with customer service, online behavior, and social media activity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The goal of a 360 degree view of the customer is to create a unified view that can be used by all teams within the organization, enhancing personalized experiences and increasing loyalty and revenue.
